title: FlowApplyOutput
description: Output of `gentry flow apply --json`: the draft became the active flow with a commit of the process repository.

applied.description: The commit that applied the flow.

sent.description: Whether the commit is sent to the remote repository; false without one or when it did not answer, and then it is sent by a later command.

sync.description: What the synchronization of the command did; present only when there is something to tell.

agents.description: What the layout of subagents in the free worktrees of the project did; present only when there is something to tell.
